Commentary.Commentary: We are back for England's reply. The players are out in the middle. Philip Salt and Alex Hales to open for England. Spin to start as Mohammad Nawaz to bowl first.
...THE CHASE....

Now the target is not a big one, the wicket is a little tricky but with the dew setting in, it could be better to bat on in the second half. Pakistan need early wickets and England know a couple of good partnerships can do the job for them. Who will come out on top? Stay tuned as we will find out after the break.

For Pakistan, it was all about Rizwan. Had he not played that knock, they would have well ended with a score below 100. However, there were far too many wickets which were gifted. Especially the two run outs and a few of the batters who played rash shots. Overall, it was a very under par performance with the bat by Pakistan.

End of an excellent performance from England with the ball and they are well and truly on top at the moment! Right from the word go, their bowlers were on the mark and made excellent use of the conditions. They seemed to have bowled with a plan, they executed the short balls really well and it worked wonders for them. The pacers were the ones who did the job, all of them got a wicket apart from Rashid. Wood was the pick but he was well supported by the rest.

OUT! TAKEN! Woakes gets his revenge and his first! Rauf walks back after that biggie and Pakistan END WITH 145! Full and on off, seems like a slower one. Rauf is early into the slog. It goes off the toe-end, high up in the air towards deep mid-wicket. Sam Curran takes it nicely.
Commentary.Howout: c Sam Curran b Chris Woakes

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! That is nailed! A welcome biggie and Pakistan are closing onto the 150-run mark! Shorter and on middle, Rauf stays back and pulls it over the mid-wicket fence. Can they get a couple more in the 7 balls left?
Back of a length and on middle, Rauf looks to drop it on the leg side and take one but is sent back.
Length and on off, Wasim guides it throught point and takes one.
FOUR! SHOT! That shot probably just indicates, the wicket is getting easier. Length and on off, Wasim stands tall and pushes it past the fielder at mid off and into the fence.
BEATEN! Shorter and outside off, Wasim looks to guide it down to third man but is beaten.
A slower one, shorter and outside off. Rauf looks to guide it down to third man but is beaten.
Angled into the pads, Rauf works it through square leg and takes two.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Rauf looks to flick but misses. Wided.

OUT! TAKEN! Straight to the man! Rizwan is out on a full toss. He will be gutted with himself. This is on the pads, Rizwan clips it but straight to fine leg. Adil Rashid takes it. He will feel a little unfortunate but he just could not get the elevation he wanted. A lovely innings by Rizwan, he was the lone warrior for Pakistan but they needed him to continue.
Commentary.Howout: c Adil Rashid b Sam Curran

Commentary.Commentary: Another short one, this is pulled through square leg for another run. Rizwan comes back on strike.
Yet another short one, outside off, Wasim looks to pull but misses.
Rizwan makes room! This is on a length and around off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Goes short again, this is pulled through square leg for one. End of a good over for Pakistan.
Fuller and on off, Rizwan strokes it wide of deep cover and takes two.
SIX! Up and over! That is a lovely stroke and welcome biggie for Pakistan! Short and on the body, Rizwan helps it on its way and over the square leg fence.
On middle, Rizwan pushes it to mid off.
Leg bye! Angled into the pads, Wasim looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Shorter and on middle, this is pushed down to long on. Rizwan thinks whether the single should be taken, eventually takes it.
Fuller and on off, Wasim looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.

OUT! TAKEN! The short ball does the trick! Aamer Jamal's stay at the crease is not a long one! Shorter and on the body, Aamer Jamal looks to pull, this goes off the glove and into the hands of the keeper. 8 down now. 150 looks far away.
Commentary.Howout: c Philip Salt b Sam Curran

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller and on middle, Rizwan works it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end. Singles won't bother England.
On the pads again, Jamal flicks it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
This is angled into the pads, Rizwan works it through mid-wicket and takes one.
A full toss, this is hit down to long off for one.
Two more! On the pads, Rizwan clips it between deep square leg and deep mid-wicket for two.
A slower one on middle, Jamal plays a check-shot towards mid on for one.
Another one! On middle, Rizwan pushes it towards mid on for one.
Good running! On middle, Rizwan works it with soft hands through mid-wicket for two.
Leading edge but safe! A single in the end! On off, Aamer Jamal looks to work it on the leg side. It goes off the leading edge towards mid off for one.
On the pads, this is clipped through square leg for one.

FOUR! Almost another one! The googly, it lands outside off and turns back in. Aamer Jamal looks to drive, it goes off the inside edge past the leg pole and down to the fine leg fence. Pakistan won't mind how they come as long as they do.
Down the leg side, this is swpet fine on the leg side for two.

OUT! RUN OUT! This is suicidal! Just poor from Pakistan! Tw run outs in the last 5 balls. They are seven down now! This is tossed up on off, it is pushed through covers. Rizwan wants two, he completes one and goes for it. The fielder runs in and fires it to the keeper. It is an excellent throw, right beside the stumps. Salt whips the bails off. It is taken upstairs. Yet again the dive does not save the batter.
SIX! Over the fence! This is in the slot. Full and on off, it is lofted over the long off fence for a biggie. Excellent way to get off the mark.
Flatter and on off, Rizwan chops it towards cover. There is hesitation but the run is taken eventually.
FOUR! Lovely stroke! This is tossed up outside off, he gets on top of the bounce and hits it through covers for a boundary.

OUT! Nawaz is well short! That is so casual from the left-hander and brilliant from Moeen! Two wickets in the over and England are well and truly on top now! On off, Nawaz looks to drop and run. He casually takes a few steps down the wicket but is sent back by Rizwan. He is slow to turn. Moeen gets to the ball from overs. Nawaz realises he is in trouble. He then looks to get back in with a dive. It is a direct hit which is taken upstairs. Replays show that the dive does not save Nawaz.
Cramps him up for room by bowling it on the body, Nawaz works it towards mid-wicket.
Really good pace! Full and on the pads, Nawaz is late on the flick and gets hit on the pad.

OUT! TIMBER! That is a jaffa! A corker of a yorker from Wood! Brilliant! Asif makes room. This is full and at the base of leg stump. Ali looks to carve it through the off side but misses and it hits the leg pole. Top stuff. Pakistan have half the side back in the hut now with the score not even 100.
FOUR! Hammered past mid on! Length and on middle, Ali hits it past the fielder at mid on and this one races away to the fence.
Fuller and on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
A bouncer to end the over, this is on middle. Ali evades it well.
Full and on middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for one more.
Short in length and on middle. Ali pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

OUT! TAKEN! The wickets keep on coming! Iftikhar Ahmed goes now and Pakistan are four down now! This is short and outside off. Iftikhar Ahmed tries to play on the up and dabs but finds Dawid Malan at backward point who takes it with ease.
Commentary.Howout: c Dawid Malan b David Willey

Commentary.Commentary: A single as this is hit to long on.
FOUR! Not a good start! A full toss on middle and Rizwan paddles it over short fine leg for a boundary.
David Willey to bowl now.
Slightly short and outside off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Mohammad Rizwan shuffles across, this is outside off, it is hit to covers for one more.
Flatter and outside off. Ahmed punches it through cover for a single.
On middle, flicked to square leg for a single.
SIX! BANG! A welcome boundary! This is full and outside off, floated. Rizwan steps down and across, reaches to the pitch of the ball and thumps it straight down for a biggie.
Tossed up, outside off. Ahmed sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Angled into the pads, Iftikhar Ahmed works it towards square leg for one.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Two more! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for two.
Two! Shorter and outside off, this is guided through point for two.
Another single as this is pushed down to long on.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
Angled into the pads, Ahmed works it through mid-wicket for one.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
The googly, it is shorter and outside off. Iftikhar Ahmed looks to cut but it goes off the underedge on the off side.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
FOUR! That is hit hard! Fuller and outside off, this is hit hard through covers, past mid off and down to the long off fence.
Another dot to end! On middle, defended.
Shorter in length and outside off, Rizwan looks to cut but is beaten for pace.
A single on the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.

OUT! TAKEN! Straight into the hands! Short and on middle, Ali looks to pull, this goes off the top edge and into the hands of the bowler. Wood takes it. Ali was beaten for pace. This was a good chance for him to prove himself but he fails to make a mark.
Angled into the pads, Rizwan works it through square leg for one.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one. It went off the pads and it is given as a leg bye.
A quick run! On the pads, this is nudged towards square leg for one.
Shorter and outside off, Ali cuts it past point for two.
On middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Tossed up on middle, Rizwan pushes it down to long on for one.
The googly, it lands on middle and turns back in a little. It is worked through square leg for one.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket for one.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a strange dismissal! England won't care though as they have another one! Masood goes for yet another low score. Lovely delivery. He sees Masood shape up for the paddle scoop and bowls a knuckle ball. Fuller and on middle. Masood is done in by the lack of pace. He is through the shot. It goes off the leading edge towards short third man where it is taken by Wood. Just as the partnership started to gain momentum, it is broken.
Commentary.Howout: c Mark Wood b David Willey

Commentary.Commentary: A single! Fuller and on middle, Rizwan hits it back towards Willey who makes a half stop. A single taken.
A yorker now on middle, Rizwan jams it back to the bowler.
SIX! Over the fence! Adding salt to the wound. Dropped on the last ball and now a biggie! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled over the square leg fence for a biggie.

DROPPED! Hales drops yet another catch! He has not been at his best in the field in this series! Fuller and on middle, Rizwan looks to go over long on but it goes off the toe-end. Hales moves to his left, dives but spills it. Should have been taken. Two runs in the end. This could prove costly.
FOUR! The last two balls spoils the over! This is short again and Masood was ready for it. He pulls it over mid-wicket and into the fence.
FOUR BYES! That took off from nowhere! Shorter and on middle, Masood looks to pull but is beaten for pace and bounce. It goes over the gloves of the leaping Salt and into the fine leg fence.
Another top edge but lands safe again! Shorter and on middle, Rizwan looks to pull, it goes off the top edge but over the keeper for one.

Top edge but safe! That is a brave effort! Goes short and on middle as he sees Masood come down the track. Masood looks to pull, it goes off the top edge. The fielder runs in but it lands short. He does well to put his body on the line and stop it. A run taken.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
Angled into middle, Rizwan works it to mid-wicket.

A HUGE APPEAL BUT TURNED DOWN! It is reviewed. The question is, has it pitched in line? NOT OUT! It has pitched outside leg! England lose a review. This is on the pads. Masood looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad. A loud shout but turned down. It is reviewed right at the end after a discussion between the England players. The review goes in vain. End of another good over from Woakes.

Mix-up but safe in the end! A slower one just outside off, Mohammad Rizwan walks across and looks to pull but misses. The ball hits the pad and rolls on the off side. There is an appeal from the bowler but nothing from the umpire. Masood is off. Rizwan hesitates but then goes for it. The fielder at point, picks the ball up but hits Rizwan. All safe in the end.
A quick run! On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket for one.
Rizwan walks across, this is shorter and on middle, it is pulled down to fine leg for one.
Shorter and on middle, Masood pulls it through square leg and takes one.
On the pads, Rizwan works it down to fine leg and gets to the other end.
Back of a length and on off, Masood defends it onto the ground.

OUT! TAKEN! The extra pace of Wood does the trick! He gets the Pakistan skipper and England have a good start with the ball! This is short and on middle, Azam looks to pull, it goes more off the top edge and Ben Duckett at deep square leg takes a good catch running to his left. Wood comes back into the side and strikes.
Commentary.Howout: c Ben Duckett b Mark Wood

Commentary.Commentary: Good length and on off, Rizwan defends it out.
Leg bye! On the pads, Azam looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Shorter and on the pads, this is pulled down to fine leg for one.
On middle, defended.
Shorter and on the pads, this is pulled down to fine leg for one.
WIDE! Willey is struggling with his line. Down the leg side. Rizwan looks to flick but misses.

A quick run! Shorter and outside off, this lands and jags back in. Azam looks to cut but gets an inside edge onto the body. It rolls on the off side. The batters go for one. Willey gets to the ball and looks to kick it onto the stumps but misses. Could have been close.
WIDE! Well stopped by Salt! Down the leg side. Azam looks to pull but misses. Salt dives to his left and stops it with one hand.
Shot! To the fielder though! Length and on off, Azam hits it on the up but to covers.
Slightly shorter and on the body, Rizwan pulls it down to fine leg and gets to the other end.
A dot to end a good over for Pakistan! Drags his length back and lands it on off, defended.

FOUR! That is a wonderful stroke! Beautiful! One of the toughest shots in the game and Azam has played it brilliantly! Fuller and on middle, Azam strokes it down the ground, past the diving mid on fielder and into the fence.
Length and on off, Azam strokes it on the up to the man at cover.
Some swing for Azam! Fuller and around off, this shapes away. Azam looks to drive but is beaten.
Two! Azam is off the mark too! Shorter and on middle, this gets big on the batter. Azam pulls it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Rizwan and Pakistan are underway! On the pads, this is worked down towards deep square leg for two.
We are all set for the action to begin! Chris Woakes has the new ball in hand. Babar Azam and Mohammad Rizwan are the openers for Pakistan. Here we go...

PAKISTAN (PLAYING XI) - Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Babar Azam (C), Shan Masood, Iftikhar Ahmed, Asif Ali, Shadab Khan (IN FOR Usman Qadir), Haider Ali (IN FOR Khushdil Shah), Mohammad Nawaz, Aamer Jamal (MAKING HIS DEBUT), Haris Rauf, Mohammad Wasim.

ENGLAND (PLAYING XI) - Philip Salt (WK), Alex Hales, Dawid Malan (IN FOR Will Jacks), Ben Duckett, Harry Brook, Moeen Ali (C), Sam Curran (IN FOR Liam Dawson), Chris Woakes (IN PLACE OF Reece Topley), David Willey, Adil Rashid, Mark Wood (IN FOR Olly Stone).
TOSS - ENGLAND HAVE WON THE TOSS AND OPTED TO FIELD!

Jos Buttler is still injured but his job as the skipper has been done decently by Moeen Ali. Still, they are missing Buttler, the batter as England could have chased down the target in the last match and could have come in this match with an upper hand. That being said, both teams are trying all the possibilities as they gear up for the upcoming World Cup. Pakistan are mostly relying on their opening stand to give the perfect start while for England, the inexperienced middle order is doing a good job. Naseem Shah's availability is a concern as he was reported with a viral fever. Also, Aamer Jamal is all set to make his debut for Pakistan. Which team will take the lead again? We will find out soon. Toss and team news coming up.
